_comment: SpreadsheetBench tasks that PASS WHEN THE AGENT DOES NOTHING -- handing
each input workbook back unmodified scores a full pass, because the graded
cell range already holds the expected values in the input.
Such a task cannot distinguish a capable model from an inert one, so it is
excluded when building a gate sample (see runner.select_gate_tasks). This
manifest is a cache, not a source of truth: run_validation_gate still
grades a no-op copy of every task it actually runs (check_no_op=True), so a
stale or incomplete manifest is caught at run time rather than silently
Regenerate with: python -m harness.cli study2 find-free-tasks
method: graded an unmodified copy of every input workbook with SpreadsheetBenchGrader.evaluate_task
